name: image
description: Responsive image with display variants, fixed ratios with a focal point, fit control, below and overlay captions, blur and skeleton placeholders, and print optimization

changes.note: Four new props and two states, all additive. data-ratio (square, 16-9, 4-3, 3-2, 21-9, portrait) gives the picture a fixed shape and crops it to fill, and the --image-focus custom property (object-position, default 50% 50%) picks what every cropping fit keeps in frame; a hover zoom now leans in toward it too. data-fit (cover, contain, fill, scale-down) sets object-fit outright, letterboxing contain and scale-down on the muted background. data-caption places the caption: below (start-aligned under the picture) or overlay (over the bottom edge on a scrim, light on dark in every theme). data-placeholder paints a placeholder behind the picture until it arrives, with no script: blur softens a tiny --image-placeholder image, skeleton shimmers for a bounded time. A script may hold the picture back with data-state="loading" and fade it in with "loaded". Markup without the new attributes renders exactly as before.

A data-hover prop: zoom (the figure clips and the image leans in by 5%), lift (rises one spacing step) and fade (the image dims to 0.8). Each also answers to focus-within, so an image wrapped in a link gives the keyboard the same cue. Reduced motion removes the transitions. No change for markup without the attribute.

Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached the img and caption with descendant selectors, so a component nested inside with parts of the same name took this one's styles. Both are the root's children. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

caption.description: Optional image caption: centred below by default, start-aligned below with data-caption="below", over the picture with data-caption="overlay"

loading.description: Optional, set by a script: the picture is held back (opacity 0) so its placeholder shows, and a skeleton shimmers until it is flipped

loaded.description: Optional, set by a script on the img load event: the picture fades in over its placeholder

hover.description: What the picture does under the pointer and under focus-within: zoom leans into the frame, lift rises, fade dims. For images that are, or sit inside, links.

ratio.description: A fixed shape for the picture, cropped to fill (object-fit: cover; the contain variant keeps containing). The focal point — the --image-focus custom property, an object-position set inline such as style="--image-focus: 78% 34%", default 50% 50% — decides what the crop keeps.

fit.description: object-fit outright, over any variant or ratio. contain and scale-down letterbox the picture on the muted background.

captionPlacement.description: Caption placement. below: start-aligned under the picture. overlay: over the bottom edge on a dark scrim, light text in every theme. Absent: centred below, as before.

placeholder.description: Painted behind the picture until the picture paints over it, with no script. blur: the --image-placeholder image (a tiny data: URI set inline as url(…)), softened; skeleton: a shimmer that stops after a few passes. Give the img width and height (or a data-ratio) so the box exists before the bytes do.

required_attrs: img must have non-empty alt attribute
